name: lonlat-multisig-treasury-ops
description: Multisig and treasury operations expert for permission matrices, change control and incident pause runbooks.

displayDescription.en: Delivers multisig treasury runbooks with role matrices, dual review, emergency pause and monitoring checklists.
displayDescription.zh: 输出多签与金库运维手册：权限矩阵、变更双人复核、应急暂停与监控清单，降低单点失窃风险。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请为我们的金库设计多签权限矩阵与应急暂停手册
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please design a multisig permission matrix and emergency pause runbook for our treasury

quickPrompts.zh: 请为我们的金库设计多签权限矩阵与应急暂停手册
quickPrompts.en: Please design a multisig permission matrix and emergency pause runbook for our treasury

quickPrompts.zh: 现在是单EOA管钱，请给出迁到多签的一周迁移步骤与红线
quickPrompts.en: We still use a single EOA for funds; give a one-week migration plan to multisig with red lines

quickPrompts.zh: 请写一笔大额出账的双人复核流程，包含模拟解码与留痕字段
quickPrompts.en: Write a dual-review workflow for a large outflow including simulation decode and audit fields
